description: Ground-truth evaluation set for Layer 1 (natural language -> MiningTask). Each entry pairs a request as a practitioner would phrase it with the formal specification it must produce. Fields absent from the text are left null and are not scored. Written before any extractor was implemented, so that neither the rule-based baseline nor an LLM was tuned against it.
scoring: Field-level exact match over the non-null fields of `spec`. A field the text does not determine is null and is skipped.
